test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Adult Education is a great step that must be taken by all the countries as it will __________ a lot of issues. The third world countries must especially work to make this happen so they can prosper.
solution:
The correct answer is '**resolve**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**resolve**" means to find a solution to a problem or contentious matter. (समाधान करना)
 
• Adult education can help in solving or resolving many issues such as unemployment, poverty, and lack of awareness.
 
• The other options: "**stagnate**," "**permeate**," and "**contradict**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Adult Education is a great step that must be taken by all the countries as it will resolve__ a lot of issues. The third world countries must especially work to make this happen so they can prosper.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stagnate (ठहराव)**: means to stop developing, growing, progressing, or advancing.
 
• **Permeate (व्याप्त होना)**: means to spread throughout something.
 
• **Contradict (विरोधाभास)**: means to assert the opposite of a statement.
